timing: User amendment after original own-policy collection completed; not retrospective preregistration.

measurements.value_gap: Top two successor V, no reward/risk/filter; not Q action gap.
measurements.raw_gap: Top two r + gamma V before safety/risk/tie penalty.
measurements.decision_gap: Top two complete scores among clearance>=0.2 candidates if n_safe>=2; n_safe==1 gives null.
measurements.all_unsafe: Separate fallback top-two complete-score gap among all 80; never pooled into safe decision gap.
additional: top5 V speeds and speed spread
actual one-step geometry with explicit robot-invisibility condition

recovery: Deterministically replay saved executed commands, verify original geometry/outcomes/selection. No new policy rollout or training; common-state metrics reuse enriched reference.

cost_gate.smoke: Original KDA/GRU/Mamba, 6 cells, first 3 saved cases
cost_gate.full: Only if all parity checks pass and projected CPU replay <=3600 seconds; otherwise report not completed, no expansion.

excluded: Training variance estimated from two seeds

reward_direction: Not cancelled; PBRS finite-budget benefit untested; no training authorized in this audit.
evidence_scale: Observed cross-training-seed differences, not a formal noise threshold.
